children.name: worker_base_url
children.label: Worker base URL (override)
children.help_text: Base URL of the Event Engine worker. Leave blank to inherit the theme-wide setting at Design Manager → Theme settings → Integrations → Event Engine worker base URL, which selects the Worker. Keep that on `Production`, which is event-engine.refuel-creative.workers.dev. The Worker formerly deployed as event-engine-staging was RENAMED to it and that hostname no longer resolves, so do not put it back. Only set a value here to override that for this one module.

children.name: portal_id
children.label: Portal id override
children.help_text: Sent to the worker as the X-Portal-Id header. Defaults to this HubSpot account's Hub ID (Weld Australia = 441838610). Set only if the worker keys tenants on a different id.

children.name: worker_event_id
children.label: Worker event id override
children.help_text: Overrides the Worker event id for ALL events on this template. Normally left blank - the per-event id comes from the HubDB row's worker_event_id column (or the row slug). Use only for a single-event demo placement.

children.name: turnstile_site_key
children.label: Cloudflare Turnstile site key
children.help_text: Public site key only. Used to show Turnstile on free public Event Engine registrations. The secret key must stay in Cloudflare Worker secrets, never in HubSpot.

name: ticket_types
label: Ticket types (fallback)
help_text: Fallback ticket types for non-dynamic placements (e.g. a single-event landing page). On the dynamic event detail page these are IGNORED in favour of the event row's `ticket_types_json` HubDB column (because one template serves every event). The Worker ticket type id must match the id provisioned in the Event Engine for this event - ask the backend (Ollie/Ryan). Price here is display-only; the Worker is authoritative.

children.name: worker_ticket_type_id
children.label: Worker ticket type id
children.help_text: The ticket type id from the Event Engine (e.g. tt_abc123). Required for the row to render.

children.name: price_dollars
children.label: Display price (AUD, dollars)
children.help_text: Display only. 0 = Free. The Worker is authoritative for the charged amount.

children.name: capture_abn
children.label: Capture buyer ABN (optional field)
children.help_text: Show an optional ABN field for company orders. The worker stamps it on the invoice; the ATO requires it for invoices >= AUD 1,000.

children.name: allow_group
children.label: Allow group registration
children.help_text: Let the buyer register multiple attendees in one order, each with their own name/email/ticket type.

children.name: waitlist_message
children.label: Waitlisted message
children.default: This event is full - you've been added to the waitlist. We'll email you if a place opens up.

children.name: confirmed_message
children.label: Confirmed (free) message
children.default: You're registered. A confirmation email is on its way.
